fields.label: 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch
fields.description: A clear and concise description of the feature proposal. Please outline the motivation for the proposal. Is your feature request related to a specific problem? e.g., *"I'm working on X and would like Y to be possible"*. If this is related to another GitHub issue, please link here too. Focus on the problem you are facing; do not include an AI-generated proposal for how to implement it.
